entities.name: Muhammad al-Kharashi

entities.summary: Abu Abd Allah Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Ali al-Kharashi was an Egyptian cleric, author and Islamic scholar who was reportedly the first Grand Imam of the Al-Azhar Mosque in Cairo.
